title: NeuroPro 2026 Year to Date

voiceover.text: Here's how NeuroPro is doing this year, January through September.
Visits are up seventy-eight percent, from three hundred forty a month in January to about six hundred five in September. Our busiest month yet.
We've served about a thousand and ten patients. Therapy is the base, and testing more than doubled in August.
From February through August, we booked one point zero one million dollars, and kept forty-nine cents of every dollar. In August, it was fifty-seven.
Each visit now brings in three hundred twenty-four dollars, and costs one thirty-nine to deliver.
But cash is lagging. Seven hundred fifty-nine thousand has come in. Liens and unpaid invoices hold most of the rest.
Three things need action now. Submit the injury backlog. Name an owner for lien collections. And work the rejected insurance claims.
The team is scaling, too. Counselor visits more than doubled, and Doctor Doran's share of visits is down from fifty-seven percent to thirty-nine.
And with nine hundred ninety-nine visits already booked for the fourth quarter, we're set up for a strong finish.

endCard.tagline: Understand the brain. Improve the outcome.
endCard.source: Source: NeuroPro Clinic Dashboard. TherapyNotes pulled Sep 30; monthly close through August (July and August are drafts).
